Mike blinked his eyes rapidly as he tried to adjust to the deep red light that soaked everything. Tall thin spires made of twisting vines and roots towered above his head. Like a poorly constructed forest missing all growth and life. The thunder from the black clouds above, echoed across the space.

He stepped out onto the wet ground, and as he looked back he saw they were climbing out of another twisted spire. Straight ahead there was what looked like the remains of a house.

Splinters of rotten wood were scattered and floating through the air. They slowly circled the house foundations as if caught in an endless loop.

A sudden haunting chime rang out behind him. Mike whipped his head around and saw a grandfather clock's face creeping from behind a spire, seemingly caught in the same loop as everything else left behind here.

Max joined him. She was putting on a brave face, but her whole body was tensed and ready to bolt.

"Holy shit", Mike whispered.


"Yeah holy shit", Max replied as she walked forward. Her shoes made a squelching sound in what Mike could now see was blood covering the ground. He followed her lead. She cautiously walked between the spires and away from the house. Her shoulders unconsciously hunched over as her eyes darted around looking for movement in the red light.

In the distance, Mike could hear echoes of music playing.


'IfIonlycould…I'dmakeadealwithGod…'


They walked around the sides of another spire and saw Max's portal. The edges of the white light gave way to red smoke as if the environment was fighting against this intrusion, but the light was holding strong.

'…andI'dgethimtoswapourplaces…'


Lucas was sitting at her bedside rubbing her cheek. Max let out a sob of relief and took two steps forward before she stopped herself, and looked back at Mike.

"Go! I'll figure it out, just get out of here already!" He encouraged her. She gave him a teary smile, "You better get out too Wheeler."

'…berunnin'upthatroad…'


Max then turned and broke out into a run, viscous blood splattered on her as she went. Her long red curls flying behind her.

'…berunnin'upthathill…'

Mike watched as she hurtled to the portal and then passed through it.



Lucas reunites with Max.


Max's smile faded, the joy of the moment waned as she remembered. "Mike".



YoubettergetouttooWheeler.


The edges of Mike's lips pulled up slightly, as he watched the portal collapse on itself when Max escaped.

'…berunnin'uptha—'


The light disappeared with it, and left him in the stormy red dusk of Vecna's mind. Mike closed his eyes to the desolate mind-scape; his mind wandered over the last few memories that led him here. That awful week without Will. Shaking his head to himself, Mike redirected his thoughts. Like Max said, happy memories.



Christmas that year; it had honestly been one of the best ones he'd had. They had finished his campaignwiththemuchanticipatedfightagainsttheThesselhydra.Willhadlandedthekillingblow withawell-placedfireball,anddespiteallhisfriendscomplainingthatthe10hourgamehadbeentoo short, he was riding the high of having his best friend back safe to play another game.

Mike breathed deep and opened his eyes. Ahead of him was another portal. Darker hues of deep blue emanated from it and he could see wooden floors and vines inside. Like before the edges rippled and flowed out, pushing against the red miasma that filled this place. Distant thudding came out from the portal. Sounds of several feet running up stairs. Will whipped around and into the visual. Mike could see his wide eyes behind the goggles and bandanna.

"Will.." Mikes voice cracked.


"Mike!" Will's voice echoed out, "Oh my god Mike please be okay!" Will desperately turned to someone out of sight, "help me get these vines off him!"

Mike went to run to the portal, to him, and fell to the ground. He yelled out in pain as his elbows and chin hit the stone floor hard and blood quickly soaked into his clothes under him. Something had his right ankle. He twisted around. A vine had wrapped itself around his foot and was climbing his leg. His eyes shifted up at some movement further back; a chill ran down his spine and froze him in place. Past his shoes, several feet away, there was what looked like a man. He was covered in layers of wet vines. His eyes were sunken in and his face looked as if all the flesh had been ripped from it exposing the muscles and tendons beneath. There was a hole where the nose should be, and it reminded Mike of a bloody skull. Mike was looking into the intense gaze of who he could only assume was Vecna.

Another vine shot out and gripped his left leg, and Mike started kicking at the restraints. "Fuck!"

Then they pulled. Dragged him roughly across the ground towards a spire. "Shit! No!"

Mike clawed at the ground in front of him. His fingers scraped across rough stone, but there was nothing he could hold onto. More vines shot out and yanked him up and backwards by his wrists. His back slammed into the spire, knocking the breath out of him. Before he could get a

proper breath back in, he felt a strong wet vine quickly wrap around his throat. He choked. His hands thrashed trying to get free to grab at the tendril cutting off his air.

"You didn't think I'd let you go so easily…did you Michael?"


The vine around Mike's neck slithered around and made another loop. Mike kept trying to get in even a small bit of air; he made a horrible wheezing noise that stuttered out of his throat.

Vecna stalked closer, moving just in front of Mike, watching with a cold air about him. In this moment Vecna was a spider observing a struggling fly.

He waved his hand and the vines around Mike's neck loosened just enough to clear his airway. Mike's lungs drew in air greedily before he started to cough. The unwelcome pressure irritated his throat leaving behind a rough scratchiness.

"You think he can save you? You think he'd want to if he knew how you felt about him?" "Fuck you", Mike spit out as he wheezed.

"He would never trust you again after knowing what disgusting things you desire to do to him." Mike shook his head vehemently as Vecna spoke, fighting against the traitorous part of his mind that agreed. "He wouldn't be able to stand being near you."

The vine around Mike's neck made another loop and gave a strong squeeze before releasing again. In the distance Will's voice echoed, "Keep cutting! They're starting to come loose!"

Mike glares at Vecna and tries to not let his fear slip into his voice, "I will always be there for him. Whether he wants me or not. Nothing will stop me, you won't stop me."

Vecna let out a small gravelly laugh.


"You think I'll let you get back to him? No, now that dear William is here, he gets to watch you die."

Vecna raised his left hand into a claw and flicks his wrist, and Mike's head is forced back, his eyes staring up at the storm clouds above him. Pure panic flushed into his system.



The vines holding Mike against the wall were slowly giving away, too slowly. Will had resorted to ripping off the tendrils with his hands. Robin was still hacking away with her knife at the sides.

Mike gave a gasp and his head jerked back, his eyes cloudy white.


"Mike!" Will yelled, "Robin get his Walkman! HURRY!" his voice raising quickly as he tore another vine from Mike's arms.


"I will break him again, this time permanently", Vecna's clawed hand hovered over Mike's face. Mike continued to struggle against the vines, but there was no give in them. They only tightened, bruising his wrists and legs. He had to put on a brave face, if only for a moment. He wouldn't die a coward.

"This won't stop him, or El. They'll kill you. You're going to lose", he managed to grit out. "No Michael, this is what future awaits your friends."

Mike's vision blackened. He felt as though he had been sapped of all his warmth. When he could see again, he stood in the Squawk. Joyce and Max were running down the hallway their eyes wild with fear. Fists pounded at the door so loud Mike felt it through his body. Mike pushed himself back against the wall as they rushed past.

The door crashed open, splintering on its hinges as military poured in. The soldiers filled the station, checking every room and corner shouting as they hunted. Mike ran after the women as two soldiers stalked down the hallway. Mike found them in the back room, Joyce's hands were shaking as she struggled to open the lock that would lead to the basement.

Mike rushed forward to help, but his hands phased through Joyce's.


"Stop what you're doing!" The soldiers were standing at the door of the room, guns aimed at them. Mike's eyes focused on the barrel facing him and his mind flashed immediately back to Lenora. The cozy Byers' home filled with deadly gunfire and screams. All the blood that covered his hands as they tried to save the agent that had protected them.

Yells confirming their find echoed back through the building. Joyce and Max raised their hands showing they had no weapons. One soldier kept his gun trained on them while the other secured their hands behind their backs with cuffs. Mike heard heavy boots clicking on the tile before Sullivan entered the room. The Lt. Colonel's steely gaze hardened when he saw that Eleven was not one of the two women captured.

"Where is she? The experiment?" he barked at Joyce and Max. Both kept their mouths shut returning the glare. Sullivan sighed and pulled out his pistol, cocked it and shot Joyce in the stomach. She dropped to the ground with a scream. Max screamed too, cursing at the soldiers, damning them.

"Mrs. Byers!" Mike yelled as he knelt next to her. She was crying out from the pain, blood soaking her shirt.

"Where is she?" Sullivan coolly demanded. Mike glared up at him.

"Go to hell", Joyce grit out.


"Fine. Take the girl for questioning." Sullivan commanded. He knelt in front of Joyce and Mike. Max thrashed against the soldiers as they dragged her sobbing out of the room. Sullivan

pressed the pistol's red hot muzzle against Joyce's forehead; despite her grimace from the pain, she held his gaze.

Mike turned away and closed his eyes as the shot rang out. An aborted sob caused his chest to spasm. The shouting of Max and the soldiers faded and a chillingly familiar screech filled the air.

Mike snapped his eyes open to the wet, dark Upside Down. Another screech. He ducked behind a nearby tree, holding onto the bark to keep his balance, looking everywhere for the demo.

Movement to his right drew his eye. He recognized the  poofy mop of brown hair, Nancy. She was wearing her crawl gear and gripping a shotgun. Looking closer he could see Jonathan behind her holding a shovel wrapped in barbed wire. They were hiding behind trees as well.

There was a shout behind him. Mike inched his face around the trunk and saw Robin on her hands and knees, a vine wrapping around her ankle. Steve was trying to pull at the vine with Lucas and Dustin's help, but it wasn't moving fast enough.

"Shit!" Nancy hissed as she ran out to help, followed by Jonathan. Another screech impacted the air, this time right next to him. Mike slowly turned. A full-sized demogorgan stood there, taking in the panicked teens; it's mouth dripping, salivating. Anticipating it's meal.

More vines were twisting around ankles and legs, trying to get ahold of them. Steve and Lucas slammed their weapons against the vines keeping them away for the moment. Robin strained up against her binds, but they held fast. She let out a sob, "You need to go."

"We aren't leaving you Robs!" Steve responded as he readied the bat facing the demo. Dustin was readying the valve on the flamethrower nozzle when he was jerked backwards. He gave a yell as another demogorgan dragged him by the fuel tanks into the treeline.

"Dustin!" Lucas and Steve ran where he disappeared. Nancy and Jonathan took defensive positions around Robin.

Mike felt the hairs on his neck stand, he could feel him.


"They will be picked off…one by one…"Vecna's graveled voice pushed into his mind.


Mike yelled into the air, "Fuck off you bastard! Stop fucking with me!" Mike hoped his voice sounded fearless.

Vecna didn't answer him. Instead the demo launched at Nancy. She managed to get a shot off in it's face before it reached her. It's claws swiftly caught her in a returning strike in the chest. She was thrown to the ground making an ugly gurgling noise.

"Nancy!" Mike ran to her, "No no! Nancy!" his voice came out high and desperate.


Jonathan yelled for her too, but the demo stood between them. Advancing. Jonathan swallowed and tried to take a stronger stance, his grip shaky. He swung and grazed it's toothed

petals before it grabbed him by the neck. It's claws dug into his throat and blood flowed out. Mike didn't want to see anymore, but the nightmare remained when he looked down at his sister.

Nancy stared at nothing. She wheezed painfully as her blood pooled beneath her from the deep gashes across her chest. "…Jonathan…"she managed to choke out. Mike's incorporeal hands moved through her hair as he tried to comfort her despite knowing it wasn't real. It wasn't real. Nancy coughed and bits of blood flew out with spittle.

Robin screeched in agony. Mike couldn't look, but he could hear the tearing of flesh, the snap of bone, and the moment her screams went silent.

Nancy's face was blanched pale and the little movements from her breathing had finally stopped.

"Killing you here would be a mercy", Vecna's raspy voice echoed softly. As if it were a benevolent offer meant to bring peace to him. Mike grit his teeth.

"Get out of my head." he pushed himself to his feet and ran into the fog through the trees.


His surroundings shifted again. He was in a cave, dark save for the flickering of lantern light coming from around a corner up ahead. Mike took a moment to breathe deep before rounding the wet stone walls. It didn't help, Mike froze as soon as he entered the cavern room.

There was so much blood. Children's bodies lay on the stone floor in a circle; their limbs twisted and deep red pouring from their eyes. Mike's breathing had turned heavy. A hollowness settled deep in him as soon as he saw the blonde pigtails.

"Holly…" he croaked. Unable to make himself move closer he fell to his knees, hands on the ground. He leaned over and began retching. The bile burned on its way up.

"Will no!" A young woman shrieked.


Mike recognized El's voice. He looked up and saw her; she was pressed against a rocky outcrop clearly unable to move against Vecna's powers. Tears poured down her cheeks as she screamed at Vecna. He was standing several feet in front of her and holding Will up in the air.

Mike could see the cuts on Will's body and his limbs shaking as he fought against Vecna's hold. Will locked eyes with Mike. His face was filled with fear, the kind he had seen a handful of times before when he had failed to stop the things Will was most scared of. Lonnie, the possession, the mindflayer, the army, and now here. He could see his mouth moving.

"Mike…"


Roots exploded out of Will's chest covered in his blood. Mike wailed as he watched Will's eyes go cold, his body limply hanging. Vecna yanked the roots out of Will and dumped him onto the ground as if he was nothing. The way his body landed was all wrong. That wasn't Will, it can't be. It won't be. They will stop him…they have to...

"You see Michael, there will be no surviving this."


"You're wrong", his voice came out shaky but clear, "you keep trying…all these years you've kept trying to attack us…attack our world…and El has beaten you…every…time. And she won't stop…not 'til you're dead."

In the distance, echoes of music called out to him, pulling him to his feet; a void had appeared beyond the cavern. He faced the darkness where the heavy baseline was pumping. A way back.

"That won't work Michael."


Mike ignored him and and ran towards the darkness. Forcing the visions out of his head with the music, hanging onto that salvation.

The void endless in front of him. He pushed forward unwavering. The music was there, but he couldn't find his way back. There were no hints of red in the distance. No portals. Just inky blackness lay before him.

'Herewestand…'


His feet slowed, and he looked behind him seeing nothing.


His anxiety spiked, would he even be able to get back? Mike slowed his breathing as much as he could.

'…worldsapart,heartsbrokenintwo…two…two…'


Panic will get him killed, just like in all the campaigns he'd run, he needs to think. The music helped, but not all the way.

'…sleeplessnights,losingground…'


Max had said that music wasn't the only way back, that it could be anything or….


Mike looked down at his hands as he remembered how he opened the portal in the first place.


…or anyone.


'…I'mreachin'foryou…you…you…'


"Will"




He blinked and the void had changed to that deep red, his back pressed against the spire again. The vines and roots twisted around him and fresh tears threatened to fall. He thought maybe now with the music and his mind on Will he could get free, but his limbs remained caught his head still pulled back watching the rotting flesh of Vecna's hand hover over him.

"There will be no more fighting from you Michael. It's time…"

"I won't—"


The vines around Mike's throat closed like a vise, making speech impossible. His last words lost to choking sounds.

"You won't be there to protect him from me, and I'm going to enjoy wringing out …every… drop… of suffering from him."

Vecna's clawed nails dug into his face and pierced the skin there. A strangled cry of pain ripped from Mike as blood trickled down.



In the upside down, Will ripped off another vine and Mike's body shifted free from the vines before he began to float upwards, caught in the curse's clutches. Will's hand flew and grabbed Mike by his shirt, yanking him down to his chest. His free hand gripped onto Mike's hand like a lifeline.



"I'm not losing you."



'Someday love willfind you…'


The second Will's hand touched Mike's, the portal pulsed and released a bright halo of golden light that burst out with an explosive blast. Mike's eyes snapped shut against the sudden brightness. The light slammed into Vecna throwing him to the ground.

'…breakthosechainsthatbindyou…'


Mike lurched as the concussive heat broke against his body and the vines holding him hissed and curled away, dropping Mike heavily to his knees. He grabbed at his throat, feeling the bruise, he coughed and fought to get air back in his lungs.

'…onenightwillremindyou…'


Vecna moved slowly on the ground nearby, in a daze, his skin making a hissing sound, damaged from the light. Mike's heart jack-rabbited in his chest. This might be his only chance. Still wheezing, he forced himself to his feet and broke out into a sprint not daring to look back.

'…howwetouchedandwentourseparateways…'


His legs felt heavy, the blood filling his shoes and slowing him down. Each stride taking twice the effort. He felt a sharp sting as a root shot out and clipped his side grabbing at him, trying to drag him back. His eyes stayed focused ahead, on the portal. On Will.

'…ifhe everhurts you…'

Spires ten to twenty feet tall around him creaked and crumbled as they began falling towards him. They crashed down barely missing him and shaking the ground under his feet.

'…truelovewon'tdesertyou…'


He felt more stings on his legs, his arms, even strands of his hair ripped out by the grasping roots. His legs were on fire as he pushed them to move faster.

Keep going. Don't stop. Don'tstop.

'…youknowIstillloveyou…'


Pain exploded from his left arm. A root pierced him, the bloodied tips poking through ripped flesh. Mike grit his teeth and yanked his arm forward with the last bit of strength he had, pulling himself free. His ears pounded with the his heart's frantic beating. With one final push, he threw himself into the portal.



The music was blasting in his ears, so much louder than before. Mike opened his eyes and looked into hazel ones. Living eyes, eyes filled with relief not fear. Eyes filling with tears. Will held him tightly against his chest. Mike dragged his feet against the wooden floor, getting his bearings. He could feel vibrations in Will's chest; Will was talking to him. Mike pulled down the headphones to rest around his neck, the music tinny but no longer overpowering.

"-thought you were gone."


Will buried his face in Mike's chest. Mike could feel the wet spots forming through his shirt and he held onto Will the best he could; squeezing as tightly as his limbs would allow.

"I'm here", needing to say it to himself just as much as to Will.
